source: local pi session logs (read-only, aggregated): session-end prompt = input + cache read + cache write of the last assistant call
method: quantiles by linear interpolation between order statistics (R-7); a session counts once, at its last call

throughput.source: local pi session logs (read-only, aggregated): all four token classes of every assistant call, per session
throughput.method: active time = sum of gaps between a session's consecutive messages, each gap capped at 5 minutes; sessions with at least 9 active minutes count; tokens per active hour per session; quantiles by R-7
